secret_key.help: Kept on the server only; hidden after saving

driver.label: Delivery
driver.help: When off, email verification and password reset are unavailable; log mode writes emails to server logs for debugging without sending

from.label: Sender
from.help: Sender address, e.g. noreply@skin.example.com, optionally with a display name

port.label: Port
port.help: Usually 465 for TLS or 587 for STARTTLS

password.label: Password
password.help: SMTP password or app token; kept on the server only and hidden after saving

encryption.label: Encryption
encryption.help: Plaintext is only suitable for a local mail relay on the same host

initial.label: Score of a new account
initial.help: Starting score granted to newly registered users

per_storage.label: Score per KB, public
per_storage.help: Score charged per KB (rounded up) when uploading a public texture

private_per_storage.label: Score per KB, private
private_per_storage.help: Score charged per KB when uploading a private texture or switching one to private

per_closet_item.label: Score to add to a closet
per_closet_item.help: Score charged when adding a texture to your closet, including your own uploads

award_per_texture.label: Award for a public upload
award_per_texture.help: Bonus score awarded only when uploading a public texture

per_player.label: Score to create a player
per_player.help: Score charged each time a user creates a new player

award_per_like.label: Award when added to a closet
award_per_like.help: Score awarded to the uploader when another user adds their texture to a closet

sign_min.label: Least check-in score
sign_min.help: Minimum score awarded per daily check-in

sign_max.label: Most check-in score
sign_max.help: Maximum score awarded per daily check-in; cannot be less than the minimum

sign_gap_hours.label: Hours between check-ins
sign_gap_hours.help: Minimum hours between check-ins when “once per calendar day” is disabled

sign_daily.label: Check in once a day
sign_daily.help: Reset check-ins at midnight in the site time zone instead of waiting a fixed number of hours

return_on_delete.label: Give back on deletion
return_on_delete.help: Refund the score originally spent when deleting a player, removing a closet item, or deleting a texture

reporter_modification.label: Score change for a report
reporter_modification.help: Negative: deposit charged on submit and refunded if upheld; positive: reward on submit and reclaimed if rejected

reporter_reward.label: Award for an upheld report
reporter_reward.help: Bonus score awarded to the reporter when the reported texture is deleted or its uploader is banned

max_size_kb.label: Largest file (KB)
max_size_kb.help: Maximum file size allowed for a single uploaded PNG texture

max_width.label: Widest texture (pixels)
max_width.help: Maximum pixel width allowed for HD skins or capes (standard skin width is 64)

name_regexp.label: Texture name rule
name_regexp.help: Regular expression texture names must match (Go RE2 syntax); leave empty for no restriction

allow_download.label: Allow downloading originals
allow_download.help: When disabled, /raw no longer serves original texture files

private_status.label: Status for private textures
private_status.help: HTTP status code returned when another user requests a private texture

content_policy.label: Content policy
content_policy.help: Shown on the upload page; supports Markdown

name_rule.label: Player name rule
name_rule.help: Allowed character set when creating or renaming a player

name_regexp.label: Custom player name rule
name_regexp.help: Used when the player name rule is set to “Custom regular expression” (Go RE2 syntax)

name_length_min.label: Shortest player name
name_length_min.help: Minimum number of characters in a player name

name_length_max.label: Longest player name
name_length_max.help: Maximum number of characters in a player name

keep_uuid_on_rename.label: Keep UUID on player rename
keep_uuid_on_rename.help: Preserve a player's UUID when renamed even under v3 UUIDs. Recommended for MUA Union and servers keying player data by UUID.

profile_cache_seconds.label: Profile cache time (seconds)
profile_cache_seconds.help: How long game clients and CDNs may cache player profile JSON responses

missing_player_status.label: Unknown players answer
missing_player_status.help: HTTP status code returned when a client queries a player name that does not exist

uuid_algorithm.label: UUIDs of new players
uuid_algorithm.help: UUID generation for new players: v3 matches offline-mode servers and changes on rename; v4 is random and stays fixed on rename

token_valid_seconds.label: Token lifetime (seconds)
token_valid_seconds.help: How long launcher sign-in tokens stay valid (default 3 days)

token_refresh_seconds.label: Token refresh window (seconds)
token_refresh_seconds.help: How long after issuance an expired token can still be refreshed (default 7 days)

tokens_per_user.label: Tokens per account
tokens_per_user.help: Signing in beyond this limit revokes the user’s oldest launcher token

search_profile_max.label: Names per bulk lookup
search_profile_max.help: Maximum number of player names accepted in a single batch lookup

skin_domains.label: Extra texture domains
skin_domains.help: Additional trusted texture hostnames, comma-separated; this site and its public storage host are always included

enable_ali.label: Send the API location header
enable_ali.help: Send X-Authlib-Injector-API-Location on every page so launchers only need the site URL

disable_authserver.label: Disable legacy Yggdrasil AuthServer
disable_authserver.help: Disable /api/yggdrasil/authserver/* password sign-in so launchers authenticate via OIDC / Yggdrasil Connect instead

access_token_ttl_seconds.label: Access token lifetime (seconds)
access_token_ttl_seconds.help: How long OAuth access tokens stay valid (default 1 day) before a refresh token is needed

refresh_token_ttl_seconds.label: Refresh token lifetime (seconds)
refresh_token_ttl_seconds.help: How long unused refresh tokens stay valid (default 30 days); each refresh rotates the token

enable_oidc.label: Enable built-in OIDC / Yggdrasil Connect
enable_oidc.help: Serve OpenID Connect, Yggdrasil Connect character selection, and Device Authorization Grant natively at /oauth/.well-known/openid-configuration (issuer path: /oauth, zero Janus) and advertise it in /api/yggdrasil metadata

enable_dcr.label: Allow launcher dynamic client registration (DCR)
enable_dcr.help: Allow native launchers to dynamically register public PKCE clients via RFC 7591 (POST /oauth/register, restricted to loopback HTTP or custom app schemes)

keywords.label: Search keywords
keywords.help: Comma-separated meta keywords for search engines; page descriptions use the site description

trusted_web.label: Trusted theme JS bundles
trusted_web.help: Theme IDs allowed to load Level-5 client override JS bundles

custom_css.label: Custom CSS
custom_css.help: Loaded as a separate stylesheet after the theme’s CSS (max 64 KB); superadmins only

custom_js.label: Custom JavaScript
custom_js.help: Loaded as a script of its own after the page is parsed, at most 64 KB. It may load further scripts. If it breaks the site, clear it with: skinloom settings set theme.custom_js null. BS custom_js.

provider.label: CDN
provider.help: Select the CDN in front of this site. Webhook POSTs purge URLs to your own endpoint for custom CDNs.

base_url.label: Site address on the CDN
base_url.help: Public URL served by the CDN, e.g. https://skin.example.com; leave empty to use the site URL

zone_id.label: Cloudflare zone ID
zone_id.help: Found on the domain’s Overview page in Cloudflare

api_token.label: Cloudflare API token
api_token.help: Requires “Zone → Cache Purge” permission; hidden after saving

access_key_id.label: Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID
access_key_id.help: Use a RAM user restricted to cdn:RefreshObjectCaches

secret_id.label: Tencent Cloud SecretId
secret_id.help: Use a sub-account restricted to cdn:PurgeUrlsCache

url.label: Webhook URL
url.help: Endpoint that receives POST requests containing the purge URL list (urls) and trigger event (event)

secret.label: Webhook signing secret
secret.help: When set, requests include an X-SkinLoom-Signature header with sha256= HMAC-SHA256 of the body; hidden after saving
